prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a person holding a modern smartphone in their left hand, with the screen facing the camera and displaying a financial or utility app interface in Greek. The app features a clean, minimalist design with a white background, orange and blue accent panels, and rounded buttons. The most prominent elements on the screen include a large orange section with Greek text, a blue section showing a balance of "95,00€", and several icons and navigation tabs. The person's thumb is visible, gently resting on the side of the phone, and their hand is well-lit, revealing natural skin texture and a casual, neutral-colored sleeve. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an indoor setting with muted green and brown tones, possibly a home or office environment. The lighting is soft and natural, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field to keep the focus on the phone screen and hand, with a slight angle that adds a sense of immediacy and realism, reminiscent of a lifestyle commercial or documentary still.
